Version component definitions: YEAR - year migratory game bird hunting season (e.g. 2026 2026-2027 season). 0 = season ongoing; used releases July following April, approximately (e.g. 2026.0.12). 1 = definitive package version entire season, indicating stable build used downgrading (e.g., 2026.1.0 April 2027 definitive version). ongoing season, bug fix released 2026.0.3 subsequent new feature released 2026.0.4. critical fixes definitive season release, avoided unless necessary (e.g., 2026.1.1).
